description: Fixture-owned trust for the frozen M2 legacy baseline. The manifest and directory pin tables are the generated tables of tag v0.1.0 (commit 7f0123444ae67c68f09b5e30cbfcc5960344103a), the build the 2026-09-21 v4 journeys were qualified against. They are copied here once and never regenerated: scripts/pin-manifests.sh does not read or write this file.

key_policy.description: Not injected: the baseline runs with this build's compiled SERVER_PUBLIC_KEYS allowlist and records it here. Descriptor keys are honoured only when allowlisted (allow_descriptor_key=false) and no key is supplied (extra_server_keys=[]). A change to the compiled allowlist fails the baseline loudly instead of silently re-judging historical anchors.
